import re from typing import List def extract_html_tags(html_content: str) -> List[str]: """ Extracts the names of all HTML tags present in a string. Parameters ---------- html_content : str A string containing HTML markup. Returns ------- List[str] A list of tag names (without angle brackets or attributes) in the order they appear. """ if not isinstance(html_content, str): # Gracefully handle non‑string input by returning an empty list return [] try: # Matches tags like
, , , etc. tag_pattern = re.compile(r'<\s*/?\s*([a-zA-Z0-9]+)[^>]*>', re.IGNORECASE) tags = tag_pattern.findall(html_content) return tags except Exception: # In the unlikely event of an unexpected error, return an empty list return []
